title: COPE: Chain-Of-Thought Prediction Engine for Open-Source Large Language Model Based Stroke Outcome Prediction from Clinical Notes

bias_targets.methodology: Subgroup analysis calculating and comparing the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of the model's stroke outcome predictions for male versus female patients.
Subgroup analysis calculating and comparing the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of the model's stroke outcome predictions across different age groups (<46, 46-64, 65-80, and >80 years).
Comparing predictive error (MAE) between patients who underwent endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) and non-EVT cases to identify performance disparities.
Evaluating model predictive error (MAE) across quartiles of discharge summary word counts to assess performance disparities based on the length of clinical notes.
